description: Search Bettrails by name: eSoccer (virtual football) players with league, matches and ELO; eSoccer head-to-heads ("lost vs troy"); NBA 2K basketball players and head-to-heads; esports (League of Legends, Dota 2, CS2, VALORANT) teams, players, champions, heroes, agents, maps, tournaments, countries. Returns pages readable with read_page. Use when the exact name, league or game is unknown (a nickname can exist in several leagues).

language.description: Language of the returned bettrails.com links (usually the conversation language). Default: es.

league.description: Optional league filter. Key = league name in lowercase, without spaces or a final "League(s)"; ggleague = GG League; volta = EsportsBattle Volta.

query.description: Name or part of it, e.g. "snak", "caps", "lost vs troy".
